# STAYX - Real Estate Agency in Warsaw

## About STAYX
STAYX is a modern real estate agency specializing in long-term rentals in Warsaw for international clients. We offer an end-to-end online booking process, legal support, and remote apartment viewings.

## Core Services
- Online Apartment Search & Selection
- Remote Video Viewings
- Legal Audit of Rental Agreements
- Remote Contract Signing (DocuSign)
- Support for International Clients (PESEL, Address registration)
